subject: English
title: Arjun and Priya Write Their Adventures
hook: Learn to write perfect letters and thrilling stories. Arjun and Priya become writers!

slides.title: The Writing Challenge
slides.storyContext: Arjun's grandmother asks for a letter. His friend Priya needs a story for her school. They decide to write together.
slides.inSimpleWords: Good writing needs planning and practice.

image.alt: The Writing Challenge — Letter and Story Writing

slides.title: Writing a Formal Letter
slides.storyContext: Priya teaches: address, date, greeting, body, closing, signature. 'Each part has a place,' she says carefully.

points.label: Letter parts
points.text: Date, Address, Greeting (Dear...), Body, Closing (Yours), Signature

points.label: Example
points.text: Date: 25 June 2026. Body: Tell why you're writing. Closing: With love / Sincerely

image.alt: Writing a Formal Letter — Letter and Story Writing

slides.title: Letter Sample
slides.storyContext: Arjun writes: 'Dear Grandma, I am fine. School is good. I miss you. Love, Arjun.' Simple and warm.

example.problem: How do I start and end a letter?

slides.inSimpleWords: Write clearly and politely in letters.

image.alt: Letter Sample — Letter and Story Writing

slides.title: Story Writing: The Structure
slides.storyContext: Priya sketches: beginning (introduce), middle (problem), end (solution). 'Every story needs these three!'

points.label: Middle
points.text: A problem or exciting event happens

points.label: End
points.text: The problem is solved or lesson learned

image.alt: Story Writing: The Structure — Letter and Story Writing

slides.title: Story Sample
slides.storyContext: Arjun writes: 'A boy lost his ball. He searched the garden. His dog found it in the bushes.' Complete story!

example.problem: How do I make a story exciting?
example.solution: Create a problem. Show how the character solves it. Use clear, interesting words.

image.alt: Story Sample — Letter and Story Writing

slides.title: Write Your Letter and Story
slides.storyContext: Priya challenges: 'Write a letter to a friend. Then write a short story about your happiest day.'

points.label: Remember
points.text: Letters are polite. Stories are creative. Both need clear handwriting.

image.alt: Write Your Letter and Story — Letter and Story Writing

slides.title: Success and Sharing
slides.storyContext: Arjun sends his letter. His grandmother replies with joy. Priya reads her story aloud in class. Both writers beam!

image.alt: Success and Sharing — Letter and Story Writing

slides.title: Write Well, Write Bold
slides.storyContext: Letters teach manners. Stories teach imagination. Both are powers.

image.alt: Write Well, Write Bold — Letter and Story Writing

subject: English
title: Arjun and Priya Learn to Talk
hook: Speaking English is an art. Arjun and Priya practice conversations every day!

slides.title: The Conversation Club
slides.storyContext: Arjun is nervous to speak English. Priya invites him to a conversation club. Together they practice every day.

image.alt: The Conversation Club — Conversation Practice

slides.title: Greetings and Introductions
slides.storyContext: Priya smiles: 'Hello, Arjun! My name is Priya. What's your name?' Arjun replies: 'Hi! I'm Arjun. Nice to meet you!'

points.label: Useful phrases
points.text: Hello, Hi, Good morning, What's your name? My name is...

points.label: Polite responses
points.text: Nice to meet you, Pleased to meet you, How are you?

image.alt: Greetings and Introductions — Conversation Practice

slides.title: Questions and Answers
slides.storyContext: Priya asks: 'How are you?' Arjun answers: 'I'm fine, thank you. How are you?' They listen and respond.

points.label: Common questions
points.text: How are you? What do you like? Where are you from? What's your hobby?

points.label: Good answers
points.text: I'm fine, thanks. I like reading. I'm from Delhi. My hobby is cricket.

image.alt: Questions and Answers — Conversation Practice

slides.title: A Real Conversation
slides.storyContext: Priya: 'Do you like books?' Arjun: 'Yes, I do. I like adventure books.' Priya: 'Me too! Which is your favorite?'

example.problem: How do I keep a conversation going?
example.solution: Ask follow-up questions. Share your ideas. Listen carefully.

image.alt: A Real Conversation — Conversation Practice

slides.title: Daily Phrases and Politeness
slides.storyContext: Arjun learns: 'Please, Thank you, You're welcome, Excuse me, Sorry.' These words make conversations smooth.

points.label: Polite words
points.text: Please, Thank you, You're welcome, Excuse me, I'm sorry

points.label: When to use
points.text: Always say please when asking. Say thank you after help. Say sorry when you make mistakes.

image.alt: Daily Phrases and Politeness — Conversation Practice

slides.title: Role Play Practice
slides.storyContext: Priya and Arjun practice: At the market, in class, at home, with a teacher. They try different situations.

points.label: Try these
points.text: Ordering food, asking for directions, making friends, joining a game

image.alt: Role Play Practice — Conversation Practice

slides.title: Arjun's Confidence
slides.storyContext: After weeks of practice, Arjun speaks English without fear. He makes new friends. His words flow naturally.

image.alt: Arjun's Confidence — Conversation Practice

slides.title: Speak With Courage
slides.storyContext: Greetings, questions, polite words. Speak daily. Make mistakes. Keep trying!

image.alt: Speak With Courage — Conversation Practice

subject: English
title: The Wise Parrot's Teaching
hook: A magical parrot teaches a king and his sons that wisdom isn't found in riches, but in truth.

slides.title: The King's Question
slides.storyContext: A powerful king finds a magical parrot in his palace garden. He asks: 'What is the greatest treasure in this world?' The parrot smiles mysteriously.
slides.inSimpleWords: A king seeks wisdom from a parrot.

image.alt: The King's Question — The Wise Parrot

slides.title: The Parrot's Trial
slides.storyContext: The parrot says: 'I will teach you, but you must listen carefully. Truth is harder to accept than lies.'
slides.inSimpleWords: Truth is often hidden in simple words.

image.alt: The Parrot's Trial — The Wise Parrot

slides.title: The First Lesson: Honesty
slides.storyContext: The parrot asks the king: 'If your minister lies to save you, and a servant tells truth that brings pain, which is greater?' The king thinks hard.

points.label: The parrot's teaching
points.text: Honesty is always greater than deception, even when it hurts

points.label: The lesson
points.text: A king who hears truth can rule wisely; one who hears lies will fail

image.alt: The First Lesson: Honesty — The Wise Parrot

slides.title: The King Tests His Sons
slides.storyContext: The king asks his three sons: 'Which is more precious—gold or honesty?' Each gives a different answer. The parrot judges their wisdom.

example.problem: When should we choose honesty over other things?
example.solution: Always. Honesty builds trust, loyalty, and real success

slides.inSimpleWords: Character is worth more than wealth.

image.alt: The King Tests His Sons — The Wise Parrot

slides.title: The Parrot's Final Gift
slides.storyContext: The parrot reveals: 'The greatest treasure is not in vaults or crowns. It lives in a pure heart that speaks truth.'

points.label: What is real wealth?
points.text: Not gold, not land, not power—but truth, kindness, and integrity

points.label: The warning
points.text: A kingdom built on lies will crumble; one built on truth will last forever

slides.inSimpleWords: Wisdom is truth spoken with love.

image.alt: The Parrot's Final Gift — The Wise Parrot

slides.title: What Would You Do?
slides.storyContext: If you found your best friend cheating, would you tell the truth and hurt them, or stay silent and comfort them?

points.label: The wise choice
points.text: Tell the truth kindly. Real friendship means helping them become better

slides.inSimpleWords: Real friends tell truth with care.

image.alt: What Would You Do? — The Wise Parrot

slides.title: The Parrot Flies Away
slides.storyContext: The parrot flies high into the sky. The king realizes: the parrot's words will echo forever in his heart and his kingdom.

image.alt: The Parrot Flies Away — The Wise Parrot

slides.title: Be Like the Wise Parrot
slides.storyContext: Speak truth. Value honesty. Choose character over comfort. These are the treasures that make a king—or a person—truly great.

image.alt: Be Like the Wise Parrot — The Wise Parrot

slides.title: New Words Learned
slides.storyContext: Treasure (precious thing), honesty (truthfulness), integrity (moral strength), wisdom (deep knowledge), deception (trickery).

points.label: Word bank
points.text: treasure, honesty, wisdom, integrity, deception, vaults

slides.inSimpleWords: New words about truth and values.

image.alt: New Words Learned — The Wise Parrot
